properties.description: One entry per distinct equilibrium found. Each entry is a state vector: one value per concept node, in the vertex order of the map that was solved. Typically there is exactly one entry, but a map with several basins of attraction yields several.

Componentwise error bound for the correspondingly-indexed centroid: for each component, the spread (max - min) across the cluster of trial endpoints that centroid represents. Index-aligned with `centroids` element by element AND component by component.

True when the map settles on finitely many discrete stable points. When false the solution carries no usable information and must be ignored.
Note that no code path in upstream v0.1.0 ever sets this to false -- both constructors hardcode `true`. Treat a `true` here as "not yet contradicted" rather than as a positive assertion of convergence. See description.md.
